content.value_statement: Marketing teams need useful content that stays consistent across channels and search goals. This skill combines brand voice analysis, SEO checks, templates, and planning guidance.
actual_capabilities: Analyze supplied text for formality, tone, perspective, readability, sentence length, and voice consistency.
Evaluate Markdown content for keyword density, headings, links, paragraph length, readability, and basic SEO scoring.
Draft blog, email, social, video, and case study content from reusable frameworks.
Adapt content to platform-specific length, timing, hashtag, accessibility, and engagement guidance.
Build monthly and weekly content plans with the included calendar template.
Suggest titles, meta descriptions, URL slugs, related keywords, and actionable optimization changes.
limitations: The analyzers use simple rules and keyword counts, not external SEO data or language models.
The skill does not publish, schedule, or monitor content on external platforms.
Keyword volume, rankings, trends, and competitor data require separate research tools.
Generated claims, facts, legal disclosures, and brand compliance still require human review.

use_cases.title: Establish a Brand Voice
use_cases.description: Analyze existing copy, select voice attributes, and create guidance for consistent future content.
use_cases.target_user: Brand managers and small marketing teams

use_cases.title: Optimize a Blog Draft
use_cases.description: Review structure, keyword usage, readability, metadata, and specific improvements before publication.

use_cases.title: Repurpose a Campaign
use_cases.description: Adapt one core message into channel-specific posts and organize publication dates in a content calendar.
use_cases.target_user: Social media managers and campaign teams

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Blog Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a blog post about [topic] for [audience]. Use a [tone] voice and end with [call to action].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner draft from a clear topic and audience

prompt_templates.title: Match My Brand Voice
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the supplied samples for tone, formality, perspective, readability, and recurring language. Then draft [content type] about [topic] in that voice.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create new content that follows representative brand samples

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Existing Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the supplied Markdown article for [primary keyword] and [secondary keywords]. Recommend improvements to headings, keyword placement, links, metadata, and readability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve a complete article before editorial review

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multichannel Campaign Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a four-week campaign for [goal] and [audience]. Define messaging pillars, channel adaptations, weekly cadence, SEO targets, metrics, and repurposing steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced campaign planning across several channels

output_examples.input: Analyze this product announcement for brand voice.
output: Voice: professional and authoritative, with moderate readability.
Consistency: strong product focus, but the final paragraph becomes more casual.
Recommendation: shorten long sentences and use one consistent call to action.

output_examples.input: Optimize a Markdown article for the phrase remote onboarding.
output: The primary phrase appears early but is missing from the main headings.
Add one internal link, shorten the longest paragraphs, and refine the meta description.

output_examples.input: Plan one week of social content for a product launch.
output: Monday: LinkedIn problem statement with a short customer insight.
Wednesday: Instagram carousel explaining three product benefits.
Friday: Email summary with a focused demonstration call to action.

best_practices: Provide audience, channel, goal, voice attributes, primary keyword, and call to action before drafting.
Supply representative brand samples and review analyzer results before applying a voice across all channels.
Verify facts, accessibility, legal disclosures, and platform requirements before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not treat keyword density or the SEO score as a substitute for search intent and editorial quality.
Do not apply one format unchanged across every social platform.
Do not publish generated claims, statistics, or customer statements without verification and approval.

faq.question: What files can the analyzers review?
faq.answer: Both scripts read plain-text or Markdown content from a user-selected local file.

faq.question: Does this skill access the internet?
faq.answer: No. The bundled scripts perform offline analysis and do not fetch rankings, keyword volumes, or platform data.

faq.question: Can this skill publish or schedule content?
faq.answer: No. It prepares content and plans, but publishing and scheduling require separate platform tools.

faq.question: How does the brand voice analyzer work?
faq.answer: It counts predefined language signals and calculates readability and sentence statistics. Results are directional, not a complete linguistic assessment.

faq.question: What does the SEO score measure?
faq.answer: It is a basic heuristic covering content length, keyword use, structure, links, and readability.

faq.question: Can teams customize the guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. Teams can adjust voice attributes, templates, keywords, channel rules, and calendar fields for their workflow.
